judge_reasoning: Prompt asks: which of the three given numbers is not equal to the other two (131 decimal, 1000 0100 binary, 8316 hexadecimal). Candidates [1] and [3] correctly convert so that 131 (dec) equals 83 (hex) while 1000 0100 (bin) equals 132, making 1000 0100 the odd one out; both end with the same correct final answer. Candidate [2] computes an incorrect hex-to-decimal value and gives a wrong final answer (2097), while [4] incorrectly claims all three are equal and outputs 131 instead.
